lines.en: I slide across the water's surface
My shadow is bigger than my body

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥没在我身上留印
lines.en: The muck leaves no mark on me

lines.zh: 我绕过芦苇，像绕开栏栅
lines.en: I pass the reeds like a fence
Each step I take, the dark deepens
I drift over without a sound
I follow the outlines of the pools
My edges blur in the fog
I pass, and the insects stop
My shape is not quite certain

lines.zh: 我从水里出来，又进水里
lines.en: I leave the water, and enter it again
I travel inside your shadow
I hover over the shallows
The fog gathers around me
I stay still, a patch of dark
The swamp night is long
I wait for something to pass
My outline shifts every moment
The water gives back no reflection of me
There is little light here, perfect
I contract a little

lines.zh: 泥里有东西在动，不是我
lines.en: Something moves in the mud, not me
You came in carrying light

lines.zh: 我不喜欢那些亮的东西
lines.en: I do not like bright things
Look at me and I grow thinner
Where I stand does not reflect
Your torch unsettles the swamp
I have been inside your shadow

lines.zh: 你一转身，我就换个地方
lines.en: Turn around and I am somewhere else
The light on you is hiding me
The swamp will keep you here
I cannot see your face clearly
Part of me was scattered
I recede half a foot
My edges are uneven now
That one stung me
I have grown fainter
I slowly gather back together

lines.zh: 你的手穿过我，还是有感觉
lines.en: Your hand passed through, and I felt it
I do not speak, dark places do not

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的位置
lines.en: That told me where you stand
I am still here, I have not left
Light draws me more than things
Put that down and I will go
I take none of these
It is too bright, I cannot approach
It blocks the light, I cannot see
Put it away, I step back first

lines.zh: 沼泽里没有什么是给我的
lines.en: Nothing in this swamp is meant for me

lines.zh: 你留着自己用，沼泽的东西我不碰。
lines.en: Keep it; I do not touch things from the bog.
That will not shine through me

lines.zh: 你举着它，我就不能靠近
lines.en: Held like that, it keeps me away
You walked into a patch of dark
I scatter, then close up again
You feel a little cold
That contact made no sound
I slip away through your shadow
Your hand found nothing
Our outlines overlapped
I retreat into your shadow
You turn to look, and I am not there
That was not a bump, just passing
There is more than one dark place here

lines.zh: 同类相遇，会合成一块暗
lines.en: When kin meet, we merge into one dark

lines.zh: 两个影子叠在一起更淡
lines.en: Two shadows overlapping grow fainter
We do not walk side by side, we overlap

lines.zh: 这一带你走，我走那一边
lines.en: You take this stretch, I take that
Another patch of dark is deep in the fog
We wait out the night together
My kind need no words
One more darkness on the water
We are both here until the fog clears
I cannot lift it, only surround it
Things are unclear in the dark
It passed through me
I moved its position
Dropped things do not interest me
This is brighter than where I was

lines.zh: 我贴在水面上滑，影子比身子大。
lines.en: I skim the water, my shadow larger than my body.
It is too solid, I cannot move it
Leave it for someone else to find
I nudge it over with my shadow
Your light is too bright
I will start with your shadow

lines.zh: 这片沼泽不欢迎带灯的
lines.en: This swamp does not welcome lamps
I have found your direction
Your shadow is on my side
I rise up out of the water
Wherever you go, you carry me
The light around you is shrinking
I know this whole stretch
You are standing in my place

lines.zh: 我还没靠近，你已经发冷了
lines.en: I have not come close, and you are already cold

lines.zh: 你没有看见我，我就在这儿
lines.en: You do not see me, and I am here
The fog helps me surround you

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我等着它灭
lines.en: You hold the torch, and I wait for it to die

lines.zh: 那水声不是我踩出来的
lines.en: That splash was not mine

lines.zh: 我的轮廓就在你的视野边上
lines.en: My outline is at the edge of your sight

lines.zh: 沼泽把影子泡软了，还是会动。
lines.en: The swamp softened this shadow, and it still moves.
Your torch is getting shorter

lines.zh: 我在等你走进暗的地方
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step into the dark
The darkness in the water follows you
I have stretched your shadow
The swamp fog answers to me

lines.zh: 你每回一次头，我就多一寸
lines.en: Each time you look back, I gain an inch

lines.zh: 你身上那点光挡不住我
lines.en: That bit of light will not stop me
I cling to the water at your feet
It grows darker where you are
I am never straight ahead of you

lines.zh: 你走的方向我比你先到
lines.en: I reach your direction before you
My sound spreads through the water
The reed shadows are mine now
When you look up, I draw back
This ring of dark has closed
The warmth on you is leaving
I am waiting for your lamp to go out

lines.zh: 沼泽的暗影，会远程打你。
lines.en: The bog shadow strikes from afar.
There is no path left through the water
I reach out of your shadow
I touched your shoulder

lines.zh: 我的指尖穿过你的护腕。
lines.en: My fingertips pass through your bracer.
I press down on your light

lines.zh: 我的手是虚的，可你会疼
lines.en: My hand is hollow, yet it hurts
I blur your sight

lines.zh: 这一撞让你的火把灭了
lines.en: That knock put out your torch
A dark spot is on you now
I stretch out suddenly from the water
You retreated into deep water
That grab dragged out a shadow
You can no longer see your feet
I wrapped around your arm
You turned in place
That left you unsteady
The fog presses down with me
I burst suddenly out of the water
My arm reaches longer than my shadow
That pressed your light down
Your own shadow tripped you
A patch of dark appears on the water
I come from deep in the fog
I was always in this swamp
My shadow reaches the bank first
When I appear, the insects go silent

lines.zh: 这里的暗不够，我补一点
lines.en: The dark here was thin, so I added to it
The muddy water bulges; that's me.
I take shape among the reeds

lines.zh: 水面被我的边缘压低了
lines.en: The water dips at my edges
I begin behind you
I have no solid body, so I am near

lines.zh: 你听见水声了，那就是我
lines.en: You heard water, that was me
The firelight drives me back a stretch

lines.zh: 我从水上掉下来，散成雾
lines.en: I drop off the water and scatter into mist
Water thins me out further

lines.zh: 爆炸的光把我整个照亮
lines.en: The blast's light lit all of me

lines.zh: 飞来的东西在我身上开了个口
lines.en: Something flying opened a hole in me

lines.zh: 那股力把我钉在水面上
lines.en: That force pinned me to the water

lines.zh: 没有光可吞，我越来越虚
lines.en: No light to swallow, I grow weak

lines.zh: 闪电把整片沼泽照白了
lines.en: Lightning turned the whole swamp white
No shadows to hide in within the void
